bibl.title: A New Fragment from P.Batav. 5 (Pathyris, May 118 BC).
bibl.seg: 141.12 / 141.4 P. Chester Beatty Inv. 2177.95 + Pap. Lugd.-Bat. XIX, 5
Todd M. Hickey & Katelijn Vandorpe, A New Fragment from P.Batav. 5 (Pathyris, May 118 BC).
bibl.note: P. Chester Beatty Inv. 2177.95 contains a substantial part of the Greek bank receipt which followed a Demotic contract (Pathyris, May 118 BC); this probably belonged to the archive of Horos, son of Nechoutes.
